notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Happy Halloween boys & girls!



We have a holiday update today.


UPDATE
- Halloween theme implemented, this will automatically activate during the Halloween period.

- Zoom in function polished and on bigger resolutions the zoom-in will be there by default



DISCOUNT
 we also enabled a discount on the TAURONOS Halloween mask DLC

https://store.steampowered.com/app/739700/TAURONOS__Minotaur_Paper_Mask_Pattern/


Enjoy 




regards,

16 BIT NIGHTS & cavalie.ro

notes.title: UPDATE language pack + easy dificulty ballance
notes.content:
Hey players,

Uncharted Greek mythology meets Asian culture through a new update for TAURONOS!

The game received an update today with the following:

Language Pack Interface and Subtitles
- Japanese
- Korean
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese

Easy difficulty better balance for beginners.


We hope you`ll enjoy hunting the hidden treasures inside the maze.


Enjoy

- Korean
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese

notes.title: UPDATE #2
notes.content:
For the ones who dare to explore the dark labyrinth

With this Halloween, we decided to make an update based on some requests we received, so here they are:

- partial controller support ( XBox 360 and compatible )
- new quit options for permadeath between stages
- more small fixes

Also, with it, we released the first DLC for TAURONOS: a pattern PDF file that, once printed, allows you to build a low-poly Minotaur mask.


And a big THANK YOU to all of you who supported this small indie project!


Happy Halloween!

tags.feature: - partial controller support ( XBox 360 and compatible )
- new quit options for permadeath between stages
